ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $O$ is a point on line $AB$, $OM$ and $ON$ are on opposite sides of line $AB$, and $\angle MON=90^\circ$, $OE$ bisects $\angle MOB$, $OF$ bisects $\angle AON$. Given $\angle BOM=150^\circ$, what are the degrees of $\angle BOE$ and $\angle NOF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
Since $OE$ bisects $\angle MOB$ and $\angle BOM=150^\circ$,\\
we have $\angle BOE=\frac{1}{2}\angle BOM=\frac{1}{2}\times 150^\circ=\boxed{75^\circ}$;\\
Since $\angle AOM=180^\circ-\angle BOM=180^\circ-150^\circ=30^\circ$,\\
and since $\angle MON=90^\circ$,\\
we get $\angle AON=\angle MON-\angle AOM=90^\circ-30^\circ=60^\circ$,\\
Since $OF$ bisects $\angle AON$,\\
therefore, $\angle NOF=\frac{1}{2}\angle AON=\frac{1}{2}\times 60^\circ=\boxed{30^\circ}$.
